note: Runtime/core fixes: shutdown_runtime(Duration::MAX) no longer panics after closing the gate (the runtime is shut down and cleanup runs); a whole-number constraint of exactly 2^63 is emitted as a float instead of saturating to i64::MAX; Schema deserializes JSON Schema boolean schemas (true -> {}, false -> {"not":{}}) in components.schemas and $defs, and the OpenAPI 3.0 boolean exclusiveMinimum / exclusiveMaximum (true moves minimum / maximum into the 3.1 exclusive bound); OpenAPI 3.1 fields no longer dropped on deserialize: Components pathItems / links / callbacks, Response links, Header required / deprecated / style / explode / example / examples / content, Parameter deprecated / allowEmptyValue / allowReserved / examples / content, Example externalValue, and x-* extensions on OpenApi / Info / Operation / PathItem (new public fields; Parameter / Response / Header / Example / OpenApi now implement Default, use ..Default::default() in struct literals); JNI dispatchDirect0 answers an out buffer below MIN_DIRECT_OUT_BYTES (1 KiB) with -(1024) without dispatching, so a panic / timeout wire always fits and a retry never re-runs a failing handler; the cancel registry hasher spreads sequential tokens (Fibonacci multiply); doc fixes (streaming dispatch_timeout scope, Validated 422 builder, envelope API limits).
